glossary.CUI: Controlled Unclassified Information — sensitive but unclassified information requiring safeguarding
glossary.CMMC: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification — DoD framework for protecting CUI in the defense supply chain
glossary.SPRS: Supplier Performance Risk System — where self-assessment scores are uploaded for DoD review
glossary.DFARS: Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement — contract clauses requiring CUI protection
glossary.DIBNet: Defense Industrial Base Network — DoD portal for reporting cyber incidents
